scope: Durable solver-research evidence assets and queryable evidence interfaces. This registry describes evidence available to research; it does not authorize production use of offline labels.

assets.name: Published level corpus and saved hints
affordances: Compare player-facing puzzle structure with solver behavior.
Mine accepted-path diversity and provenance without re-solving the corpus.
Provide the published source population for solution-space profiles and current solver comparisons.
caveats: Saved hints and known paths are offline labels and may not steer a cold production solve.
Published levels are repeatedly inspected development material, not an untouched generalization sample.

assets.name: Stress corpora, construction witnesses, and generation provenance
affordances: Stratify findings by generator/source rather than treating all hard levels as exchangeable.
Use construction witnesses to establish solvability and localize solver divergence without granting the solver a hint.
Separate solver-aware Corpus-1 batches, solver-blind Corpus 2, and the in-envelope stratum when checking robustness.
caveats: Construction witnesses prove solvability, not cold solver capability.
Corpus 2 has been heavily mined and is a development/capability laboratory rather than untouched evidence.
Rows from the same generator or family may not be independent for a broad claim.

assets.name: Hint discovery provenance
affordances: Distinguish witness, human, exhaustive, randomized, production-solver, isolated-technique, hint-guided, and other discovery classes.
Recover exact solver/configuration, work, nodes, termination, seed, forcing, and run-context information for independent rediscoveries.
Mine same-config cost drift and source-specific solution-space sampling without rerunning historical searches.
Test whether an apparent technique or corpus effect is confounded by how known solutions were discovered.
caveats: Coverage differs by corpus/source and legacy entries may have unknown fields.
A stored path can have multiple provenance entries and therefore multiple source memberships.
Provenance is powerful offline evidence but must not become level-specific runtime steering.

assets.name: Canonical structural level fingerprint

locations.path: v2 fingerprints computed from canonical level structure; values also occur in provenance context.levelRevision

affordances: Join persisted evidence to a stable structural revision even when field insertion order or hints change.
Detect duplicate/same-structure observations and stale provenance across level revisions.
Provide a forensic join key distinct from corpus position or mutable display metadata.
caveats: The fingerprint is an identity/deduplication primitive, not a legal production nearest-neighbor feature.
Legacy fingerprint versions are migration support; compare through the owning implementation rather than raw-string assumptions.

assets.name: Offline solution-space fingerprints/profiles
affordances: Measure path-mode diversity, rigidity, footprint, objective-satisfaction depth, portal use, turn structure, must-cross order, and discovery saturation.
Compare solver response with independent descriptions of known solution-space structure.
Stratify profile summaries by provenance source to expose sampling artifacts.
caveats: Profiles are derived from known solutions and are forbidden direct production-routing inputs.
Homogeneous stored hints do not prove the true solution space is rigid unless provenance establishes exhaustive search.
Similarity may encode family/generator ancestry rather than a causal solver mechanism.

assets.name: Solver determinism fingerprints

locations.path: solver:fingerprint outputs selected by the invoking investigation

affordances: Detect semantic/search-order drift that solve totals can hide.
Separate deterministic behavior changes from pure wall-time changes.
Support before/after regression attribution when implementation or naming migrations touch execution plumbing.
caveats: These fingerprints describe solver behavior, not level geometry or solution-space structure.
Fingerprint parity does not establish generalization or performance value.

assets.name: Current isolated technique × level census and capability map
affordances: Expose rare/exclusive capability, substitutions, inversions, multiplicity, cap/tranche economics, and oracle-frontier headroom.
Define response vectors that can be joined to solution structure, provenance, geometry, variants, or live production behavior.
Distinguish an unavailable capability from a capability that production simply fails to schedule.
caveats: Isolated success is nomination evidence, not automatic production value.
The matrix is heavily mined development evidence and historical technique identities must normalize through current owners.
Raw nodes compare depth within a technique; cross-technique allocation uses workSpent.

assets.name: Current and historical production solver benchmark outcomes

locations.path: reports/stress/** solver benchmark and refresh outputs

affordances: Provide the actual product-objective solve/work outcome that offline diagnostics must eventually explain or improve.
Support solved/unsolved, budget-edge, stability, regression, and cost-drift joins.
Anchor census/profile/variant associations to current production response.
caveats: A latest pointer is a convenience, not timeless authority; inspect embedded commit/protocol metadata.
Historical results must be reconciled to current code, budget semantics, and identity vocabulary before decision-bearing use.

assets.name: Production attempt lifecycle and allocation telemetry

locations.path: solver-stress-refresh and lifecycle-failure-map reports under reports/stress/

affordances: Show which actions were reached, skipped, starved, exhausted, or continued and how much comparable work they received.
Separate routing/allocation failures from true isolated search-quality failures.
Join live production response to census rescuer value and tranche economics.
caveats: Historical lifecycle telemetry is observational when predecessor state, sequence, or budget differs.
Stage/action identities changed during naming cleanup and must normalize through owning compatibility boundaries.

assets.name: Known-solution-prefix survival observations

locations.path: known-solution-prefix survival captures and analyses selected by investigations

affordances: Locate where known-valid support disappears across generation, prune, dedup, scoring, width cull, and diversity selection.
Distinguish failure to generate viable material from failure to retain or rank it.
Nominate exact-prefix and paired-trace follow-up at a concrete decision boundary.
caveats: Known-support extinction is not proof that every true solution is extinct.
Known paths are offline labels and observer mode must preserve search parity.

assets.name: Method probes and bounded operational traces

locations.path: method-probe, paired deterministic trace, and beam-trace outputs selected by investigations

affordances: Explain why two configurations with similar outcomes are operationally different or vice versa.
Locate first deterministic divergence in ordering, pruning, retention, dedup, or branch choice.
Turn an aggregate census/variant anomaly into a concrete recurring mechanism.
caveats: Bounded or truncated traces are censored observations, not proofs of full-search equivalence.
Trace-selected examples are forensic/discovery evidence unless independently sampled.

assets.name: Exact/reference feasibility and explicit-prefix labels

locations.path: CP-SAT/reference probe outputs and committed labelled branch sets under reports/stress/

affordances: Label selected prefixes/states live or dead when the model supports the mechanics and terminates decisively.
Distinguish a ranking/retention mistake from genuine infeasibility.
Provide independent labels for replay probes and reduced counterexamples.
caveats: Timeout and unsupported mechanics are abstentions, not dead/UNSAT labels.
Every model-emitted or pinned witness used as evidence must be reconciled with the canonical referee.
Reference-model support is incomplete and must be checked before interpreting a null.

assets.name: Offline replay atlas of labelled solver states

locations.path: CP-SAT-labelled branch sets and offline-replay outputs under reports/stress/

affordances: Test candidate reasoners against already-labelled real solver states without modifying production search.
Measure dead catches, live false rejects, unique catches, overlap, abstention, and firing depth before buying a live experiment.
Reuse expensive exact labels across multiple narrow hypotheses.
caveats: The atlas is a selected research sample, not automatically representative state-distribution evidence.
A strong replay classifier still needs cost, live solve/work, and independent confirmation before promotion.

assets.name: Controlled variant-family datasets and family index
affordances: Use controlled transformations to localize structural causes of solver cliffs.
Study orientation, density, mechanic, repair, retention, and action-value changes while holding ancestry comparatively fixed.
Test whether census/profile/telemetry associations persist under interventions instead of unrelated-level correlation.
caveats: The large canonical resource is deliberately off main and should be mounted read-only while current code supplies the tools.
Sibling variants are correlated; parent family is the independent unit for broad generalization.
Historical solver observations must be rechecked on current code before promotion.

assets.name: Experiment and family-run manifests

locations.path: manifest artifacts emitted beside decision-bearing solver/family runs

affordances: Recover exactly what code, population, flags, workflow inputs, seeds, budgets, and output produced a result.
Detect invalid A/B comparisons where non-treatment dimensions changed.
Join family observations to solver/data provenance without reconstructing invocation history from filenames.
caveats: Older artifacts may predate current manifest schemas and must remain explicitly historical/unknown where fields are absent.
A valid manifest establishes provenance/comparability, not efficacy or independence.

assets.name: Tracked raw logs, baselines, and historical run evidence

locations.path: tracked exceptions and historical snapshots classified by logs/artifact-metadata.json

affordances: Recover raw evidence behind dated reports and compare current behavior to historical baselines.
Distinguish current pointers, compatibility baselines, historical snapshots, and source evidence using machine-readable classification.
Support regression attribution when a current aggregate hides which levels or attempts moved.
caveats: logs/Solver is a frozen legacy attic and not a current output destination.
latest pointers are not independent evidence and historical artifacts are not current capability by existence alone.

main's git history for many pre-2026-09-03 tracked files (e.g. scripts/stress/feature-solvability-analysis.mjs, data/levels.json) was squashed into a single 2026-09-03 merge commit -- git log/blame cannot recover when these files actually changed prior to that date. Only a file's own embedded generatedAt/timestamp fields are trustworthy for pre-merge chronology (see reports/2026-09-05-routing-regime-archetype-risk-three-point-refinement-001.md).

assets.name: Machine-readable index of current research authority and prior reports
affordances: Find prior experiments, current decisions, remaining gates, and linked artifacts before rerunning work.
Search historical naming-era stage/routing/attempt vocabulary through current identity normalizers.
Expose evidence that is not already linked from the active workstream narrative.
caveats: The index routes to evidence; it does not replace reading the decisive report/artifact.
Legacy reports without structured metadata remain searchable but have weaker machine-readable status.

assets.name: Static level descriptors, heatmaps, and feature analyses

locations.path: feature-solvability, corpus-query, and related descriptor outputs

affordances: Stratify solver outcomes and technique-response cohorts by legal static puzzle descriptors.
Translate offline labels such as solution-profile or census associations into candidate level-blind descriptors.
Identify geometry/mechanic confounds before attributing an outcome difference to a solver mechanism.
caveats: Feature/outcome correlation is nomination evidence, not causal routing evidence.
High-dimensional descriptors can accidentally become identity/family proxies and require held-out confirmation.

assets.name: Failure inbox and curated diagnostic cohorts

locations.path: data/stress/*population.json, *ids.txt, and curated diagnostic selection artifacts

affordances: Preserve which failures were already inspected or selected for a bounded investigation.
Recover selection provenance for targeted cohorts so they are not later misrepresented as random samples.
Route recurring cases toward lifecycle, trace, exact, or variant follow-up.
caveats: Curated cohorts are selected evidence; they cannot estimate population prevalence without a separate sampling design.
Triage state is workflow metadata, not a solver capability label.

relationships.join: levelId plus provenance-source bucket and, when needed, hint path signature
questions: Is apparent solution-space rigidity a property of the puzzle or of the discovery source?
Do technique-response cohorts differ by independently sampled solution mode?
relationships.boundary: Offline diagnosis only; provenance/profile labels do not become runtime routing inputs.

relationships.join: levelId plus normalized solver/configuration identity and comparable work fields
questions: Did the same configuration historically solve this level at materially different work?
Is a current regression/cost cliff likely semantic drift, search drift, or historical protocol mismatch?
relationships.boundary: Historical rediscovery is nomination/forensic evidence until protocol and code comparability are established.

questions: Was this hint/result produced against the same structural revision?
Are apparent duplicate observations actually the same puzzle structure?
relationships.boundary: Use as identity/revision evidence, not a production nearest-neighbor lookup.

questions: Does production fail because a useful technique is never reached/starved, or because it also fails in isolation?
Which useful work tranches are missing from live allocation?
relationships.boundary: Sequence-dependent isolated capability remains observational until controlled in the production context.

questions: Do stable technique niches correspond to basin width, rigidity, turn/portal structure, or objective-satisfaction depth?
Can an offline association be translated into a simpler legal level/state descriptor?
relationships.boundary: Any descriptor selected from these joins is development evidence and requires independent confirmation.

relationships.join: parent/variant level identity mapped to current normalized technique/configuration response
questions: Which controlled structural transformation flips technique value or useful budget depth?
Is a census niche causal/stable within related puzzle neighborhoods?
relationships.boundary: Analyze by parent family and re-run decision-bearing historical outcomes on current code.

relationships.join: parent/variant identity plus matched solver config/ref
questions: Where is the first operational divergence between a solved parent and unsolved close relative?
Does an orientation/density/mechanic cliff originate in legality, ordering, retention, dedup, or randomness?
relationships.boundary: One sibling pair is a mechanism case study; recurrence across unrelated parents is needed for generalization.

questions: Was material culled while a live continuation still existed?
Was an extinction event a ranking/retention mistake or genuine infeasibility?
relationships.boundary: Known paths guide offline labeling only; timeout/unsupported exact probes abstain.

questions: Can a candidate reasoner separate live/dead states before production integration?
Does it add unique catches beyond the existing gauntlet without live false rejects on supported labels?
relationships.boundary: Replay quality does not establish live solve/work value or mathematical soundness beyond tested coverage.

questions: Which legal level features stratify current failures or budget-edge solves?
Are solver-response differences confounded by generator batch, geometry, or mechanic envelope?
relationships.boundary: Observational feature correlations nominate hypotheses; selected thresholds require held-out confirmation.

relationships.join: runId/experimentId/output artifact plus solver ref and level selection hash
questions: Are two purported A/B arms actually comparable?
Which code/data/protocol produced this result?
Can a historical artifact be safely joined to current evidence?
relationships.boundary: Provenance/comparability is necessary but does not establish statistical independence or efficacy.

relationships.join: report/artifact paths plus normalized topic/stage/routing/attempt terminology
questions: Has this premise already been tested under an older name?
Which raw artifact or remaining gate sits behind a current decision?
relationships.boundary: Use the index to discover evidence, then read the owning report/artifact before acting.

questions: Did a solve/work regression accompany a deterministic search-order change?
Is a performance change semantic or merely implementation latency?
relationships.boundary: Fingerprint differences localize change; they do not by themselves determine whether the change is good or general.

relationships.join: selected corpus + levelId with recorded selection provenance
questions: What is the cheapest next instrument for a recurring failure class?
Can a selected anomaly be converted into a controlled family, trace, or exact-label question?
relationships.boundary: Preserve the selected nature of the cohort; do not use it as prevalence evidence.
